title: Influence of treatment expectations, resources and stress factors on the psychological well-being of adolescents and young adults during proton therapy: Identification of requirements for support and potential for intervention
summary: Many new cases of cancer are diagnosed every year in adolescents and young adults (AYA) aged 16 to 39. Proton therapy plays an important role in their treatment. The AYA age group has different life tasks, different potential stress factors and different needs than younger patients and also than older adults. The aim of our study is therefore to better understand the situation of AYA patients before and during proton therapy. With the help of questionnaires and group interviews, we would like to record expectations of proton therapy, concerns about possible side effects, possible stressful and supportive factors and the well-being of these patients during the course of treatment. The findings should help us to better understand the needs of AYA patients and to develop suitable support services in the future.
conditions: All patients aged 16-39 years who receive proton therapy at the WPE according to a justifiable indication are included.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Participation in the WPE internal registries KiProReg (13-5544-BO) or - ProReg (12-5143-BO) with appropriate consent
- Proton therapy at the WPE with justifying indication 
- Signed informed consent for the study
- Sufficient oral and written knowledge of the German language
Exclusion criteria:
- Age: under 16 years and over 40 years
- No written consent for the WPE register and/or the prospective study
- No oral and written knowledge of the German language
